about_short_description.short_description: Clearest Health helps health plans and employers improve benefits using advanced tech and clear data.

product.name: Decision Support
product.description: Analyzes every claim for risk, value, and compliance, then recommends actions to help health plans act faster and prevent leakage.

product.name: Program Integrity
product.description: Continuously scans claims for errors, overbilling, and policy mismatches, automatically flagging items that require review.

product.name: AI Claims Guidance
product.description: Automates most claims adjusting and guides specialists to focus on critical, high-touch, and high-cost claims.

product.name: Intelligent Document Processing
product.description: Uses AI to parse and analyze claims documentation, ensuring accurate data capture and reducing manual data entry.

product.name: Plan Intelligence
product.description: AI agents scan all plan activity to flag issues, provide real-time spend breakdowns, and generate automated reports for health plans.

product.name: Live Dashboard Sharing Platform
product.description: Enables sharing of live dashboards with clients, brokers, and partners for instant access to claim details and trend insights without using PDFs.
